newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, light ends weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, light ends weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, with light ends the weakest part of the barrel.
Naphtha eased with crude in late trade. Tight avails limited losses and trade was thin as buyers and sellers stood apart.
Gasoline was also easier, but tight high octane supply and good barge demand underpinned the market.
Gas oil premiums were firm with traders reporting a dearth of heating oil and low sulphur diesel in the ARA region.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges were firmer again, trading between $119 and $121 fob ARA.
